description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Category' controller class within the OpenCart system. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and management of product categories in the admin panel. The class extends a base controller and includes methods for listing categories, viewing details, creating, editing, and deleting categories, as well as setting up related data such as filters, store associations, descriptions, and validations.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing product categories in the admin interface, including listing, form handling, and deletion.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the categories list page in the admin panel.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the category list page response generation.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view of the categories list with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the category creation or editing form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a category.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the category form input data.

methods.name: validateDelete
methods.description: Validates if selected categories can be deleted.

methods.name: repair
methods.description: Repairs the category hierarchy or structure.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for category names, used in search fields.
